host_steps.evidence: 009EB686 MOVSS XMM0,[EAX+1D8h] after the call; reached only when sector+14h was set on entry (009EB66E).
009EB92E MOV ECX,[ESI+3FCh]; 009EB934 MOV EAX,[ECX]; 009EB936 MOV EDX,[EAX+50h]; CALL EDX. The arc arm only.

ECX = LEA [ESI+0A3Ch]; three pushes (the probe point at E+20h, the far point at E+30h, the out slot at E+3Ch) and RET 0Ch. Gated on [blk+0A3Ch] != 0 at 009EB778 and on the byte blk+0A24h at 009EB7AA. The straight arm only.
ECX = &[ESP+30h], the crossing point minus the probe origin; the result replaces the range at [ESP+10h].
ECX = *cursor, one push of &[ESP+20h] (the probe point). A true result breaks the loop at 009EB925 and records the index straight away.
PUSH EBX with EBX = LEA [ESI+184h], the hull position. ECX is the neighbour the previous call left there. A true result skips the neighbour.
three pushes (&origin at E+28h, &direction at E+44h, &range at E+10h) and RET 0Ch; 009EB8EB..009EB8F6 keeps the result only when it exceeds sector+0Ch.
ECX = LEA [ESI+0A3Ch]; four arguments (&centre at E+44h, the radius sector+4h, the start bearing, &swept bearing at E+10h) and RET 10h. Gated the same two ways at 009EBD4C and 009EBD70.
the arc arm's copy, with &[ESP+3Ch], the start point pushed one clearance along the hull forward vector.
four arguments and RET 10h; 009EBE3F..009EBE7D turns the bearing change into an arc length by multiplying by sector+4h and keeps it only when it exceeds sector+0Ch.
009EBEF7 FLD [ECX+78h]; 009EBEFE FCOMIP; 009EBF02 JBE; 009EBF0A MOVSS [ECX+78h],XMM0. The compare-and-store pair is the whole operation, so the host carries the raise.
the unit arm reads the heading again and turns it by pi at 009EBF39 when sector+0h is zero.
five pushes and RET 14h: &out at E+44h, EBX = &hull position, the reference heading, [node+88h], &flag at E+0Fh. EAX comes back as the out pointer, read at 009EBF6C and 009EBF71.
009EBFF3 MOV ECX,[ESI+3FCh]; 009EBFF9 MOV EDX,[ECX]; 009EBFFB MOV EAX,[EDX+50h]; CALL EAX. The avoid-zone arm's own read of the heading.
ECX = LEA [ESI+0A24h]; one push of &[ESP+4Ch], the 0x24-byte block 009EC077..009EC0BB fills. The bearing is read back from block+1Ch at 009EC0CE.
SUB ESP,14h at 009EC20B and five stores: 10.0f (00CE38B8), 0.0f, 150.0f (00CE3808), 8 degrees (00D20A18) and the distance.

corrections.was: docs/SHIP_AI_OBSTACLE_TABLES.md sector table: `+4h` is the `half width of the probe`
corrections.is: `+4h` is the probe's turn radius, and a negative value (-1.0f) selects a straight probe instead of an arc
corrections.evidence: 009EB69F COMISS against +0.0f with 009EB6AE JBE picks the two arms; 009EBA84 FDIV divides the clearance by it to get an angle and 009EBA8A divides the arc length by it to get the swept angle; 009E034A / 009E03B1 write 00D7A260 = -1.0f into buckets 2 and 3

corrections.is: `+0Ch` is a small longitudinal clearance, one tenth, one fifth or one half of blk+3E4h = unit+9C8h * 0.45. It is the distance the probe point sits ahead of (or astern of) the offset origin, the angle the avoid-zone arc starts off the beam bearing, and the minimum travel a hit must exceed to count
corrections.evidence: 009E0345, 009E037B, 009E03AC and siblings write it; 009E44DB FMUL against the double 0.45 at 00CF1748 makes blk+3E4h; 009EB7B8, 009EBB6E, 009EBD24 place the probe point; 009EBA7F and 009EBD59 make the start angle; 009EB8EB and 009EBE72 are the two minimum-travel tests

corrections.was: the same table: `+10h` is the `lateral offset`; `+0h` is the `kind byte`
corrections.is: confirmed and made precise. `+10h` is a signed lateral offset of +/- unit+9CCh / 2.2 or +/- unit+9CCh / 4, and its sign selects which beam vector the arc centre is offset along. `+0h` is the direction: non-zero is the ahead fan, zero the astern fan
corrections.evidence: 009E0336, 009E036C and the four FCHS siblings write +10h; 009EB9E1 and 009EBB9B test its sign against +0.0f at 00D7A218; 009E0338 SETZ writes +0h as (group == 0); 009EB725 negates the hull forward vector and 009EBD38 subtracts the clearance when it is zero

corrections.was: docs/SHIP_AI_OBSTACLE_TABLES.md: "`[sector+24h]+88h` is the passing side the other ship picked and `sector+28h` is the one this ship picked, both written by the same 009D84E0 side flag in 009EB660"
corrections.is: 009EB660 never writes node+88h; it only reads it (009EBF51) and passes it to 009D84E0 as the side to bias against. The only instruction in the image that stores a non-zero value into a node's +88h is 009D912F in BSP_ShipAi_PredictTrackCrossing, which in one arm copies the other party's +88h (009D90C7). Every other writer clears it: 009E5364 and 009E5417 in the two constructors, 009D803A and 009D8086 in 009D8010, 009D8C80 in 009D8C60's zero arm, and 009F019F, 009F06EC, 009F073C, 009F09C7 in 009F0100
corrections.evidence: a whole-image scan of the C7 /0 and 89 /r forms with the disp32 0x88 (local/find_store88.py); 009D8C60's non-zero arm builds a message with 009D66B0 and routes it with BSP_Session_RouteMessage rather than storing, so the value is replicated rather than assigned locally

corrections.was: docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md milestone 2p follow-up 6: "the neighbour list blk+604h / blk+608h. The refresh runs 15680 times and marks nothing"
corrections.is: the list is inline in the control block, capacity 0x80 pointers spanning blk+608h..blk+807h, which is exactly where the sector array begins. Its producer is BSP_ShipAi_BrainPrePass through 009F0D20 at 009F1A25, throttled by the accumulator gate at 009F515B, and its candidates are the world's unit list at [[00E188A8]+19CCh] filtered by an altitude band of 15.0 and a closing-distance radius
corrections.evidence: 009F0D39 CMP against 0x80; 009F1877..009F18B8 walks the list (count +60h, head +64h, payload +8h, next +4h); 009F1929 compares against the double 15.0 at 00CF3F20; 009F1987..009F1A1F is the radius test

run_time_evidence.claim: no sector is ever marked blocked in bsp_game.exe
run_time_evidence.evidence: docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md milestone 2p states the refresh runs 15680 times and marks nothing because the neighbour list is empty in that process. This packet adds the reason rather than a new run: nothing in bsp_game.exe reaches 009F1A25, the sole append site, and the avoid-zone object blk+0A24h / blk+0A3Ch is the scan's only other input. Wiring either is a milestone in the executable's own packet, not this one; src/ship_motion_probe.cpp and the game executable sources belong to cc-exe-2q and were not touched.

flow_gaps.evidence: `python tools/bsp.py ghidra flow 009f0ea0` reports one gap of ten bytes after the CALL to 00BF65AC. The disk bytes are ADD ESP,4; ADD EBP,1; MOV [ESP+1Ch],EBP, the increment of the removal count the compaction at 009F1112 and the count fixup at 009F114E both depend on. The projection uses them; the listing does not have them. `python tools/ghidra_flow_repair.py 009f0ea0 --apply` is the integrator's step.

uncertainties: Which of blk+19Ch/+1A0h and blk+1A4h/+1A8h is the port beam vector is inferred, not read: the arm that offsets the turn centre along blk+19Ch/+1A0h passes heading + pi/2 as the bearing from the centre back to the hull (009EB9FD, 009EBA9A), which forces blk+19Ch/+1A0h to point at heading - pi/2. Their producer, 009DE2F0 at 009DE462 with defaults in 009DFCB0, was not read.

00811A30 returns a class curve 0082E960 evaluated at the rudder fraction 0.5f, divided by the gameplay modifier product for category 5. That the sector uses it as the radius of a turning circle is what the geometry needs, but 0082E960 was not read, so `turn radius` is a hypothesis about the curve.

The neighbour node's two oriented boxes share the axis pair +28h..+34h in the containment tests (009D80C0, 009D8160) while the corner builders use +4Ch..+58h for the second box (009D84E0, 009DD010, 009DD540). That is what the listing says. Whether the two pairs are kept identical by 009EAE20 and 009EAFC0 was not checked; neither was read.

The meaning of the passing side codes 1 and 2 is not settled. 009D84E0 penalises the side matching the argument by 25 degrees, so a node whose +88h is 1 pushes this ship toward code 1, and 009F3F80 backs off when the node's +88h differs from the sector's choice. Which absolute side each code names was not established.
009DC2E0's query block is described by what 009EB660 writes into it and reads back. The two 5.0f at block+10h and block+14h and the context pointer at block+20h (blk+0A38h) are passed through unread.

blk+0A24h is treated as an inline avoid-zone object whose first byte is an enable and whose +18h (blk+0A3Ch) is the head of a segment tree. That is from its two uses here (009EB7AA tests the byte, 009EC0AF passes the address as `this`, 009EB819 and 009EBDAA pass &blk+0A3Ch as `this`); the object itself was not read.

build.detail: src/ship_ai_sector_scan.cpp builds clean under /W4 /WX for Win32; the existing reconstructed_math test still passes. No new test case was added: every routine here is a projection whose evidence is the listing, and the four math helpers it calls (00419010, 00438AA0, 00438B10, 00414C60) already have their own coverage.
